# Connector

> Connector is a self-hosted operating substrate for intelligence: identity, admission, isolation, memory, and audit on one node.

Agents, models, tools, and workflows run on it. Isolate, govern, stop, prove. Three institutions are ready to try in 90 minutes: DevGuard, TraceTramp, WitnessCtl. Seven more workflows are the plan. Institutions sit on the OS. They are not the OS.

## Honesty
- Not a coding-agent product (DevGuard is one institution)
- Not Firecracker-by-default (world dials use dest-pinned Landlock children)
- HMAC-chained receipts a reviewer can inspect — not a sold SOC 2 / HIPAA / FedRAMP checkbox
- Stop is not undo
- Memory and journals stay on the node; vendor LLM HTTP may leave when a model is granted
- Default listen is :9091 (`connector-platform`)

## Best for
- Platform teams operating internal agents
- Security and compliance teams who need inspectable receipts, not a certificate
- Engineering teams running agentic workflows in production
